items.title: A quadratic vertex lower bound for algebraic branching programs via depth reduction robust to structured errors
items.author: Prerona Chatterjee; Mrinal Kumar; Adrian She; Ben Lee Volk
items.source_version: CCC2020 official complete21-page CC BY3.0 Unported publication. MainTheorem2/detailedTheorem7 with complete published Sections2–3 quadratic ABP proof. Nonexclusive arxiv v1/v2 private aids only.
items.difficulty_reason: The proof depth-reduces a small ABP without increasing its vertex count while controlling a sum of zero-constant products as error, then uses an algebraic-variety dimension argument to keep the quadratic lower bound robust under those accumulated errors.
